{"task": {"id": "I_kwDONElfw88AAAABVyMEIg", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4BlV6Pzg_Ufmc", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4BlV6P", "number": 28, "title": "Implement PMX bone morph playback with local real-model verification", "body": "## Goal

Implement **PMX type 2 bone morph** runtime behavior for models and VMD morph animation. At present, `MMDLoader.GeometryBuilder` produces an unchanged position morph target for type 2 and marks it TODO. VMD morph weights are animated through `morphTargetInfluences`, but those weights do not affect target bones.

**Parser prerequisite:** [mmd-parser#25](https://github.com/takahirox/mmd-parser/issues/25) must first fix the right-handed conversion of bone morph translation/quaternions, and a new parser version containing that fix must be published to public npm by the maintainer. Integrate against that released version, update dependency and lockfile; do not vendor or locally patch an unpublished parser.

## Functional scope

- Preserve type 2 bone morph payloads (affected bone indices, position offsets, rotation quaternions) in loader runtime data and associate each PMX morph with its existing morph weight/index/name.
- Apply morph weights to affected bones every animation/pose update, both for direct interactive morph-weight changes and VMD morph tracks. Translation scales with weight; rotation interpolates from identity to the morph quaternion, with correct order and composition for multiple morphs affecting one bone.
- Avoid drift or accumulated transforms: pose reset, paused playback, seeking/scrubbing, looping, disabling morphs and repeated `update(0)` must remain stable.
- Keep existing bone VMD animation, vertex morphs, IK, grants, physics and SDEF rendering functional. Define/test ordering of bone morph application relative to those systems; do not silently double-apply morphs when `pmxAnimation` mode is enabled.
- For the initial issue, limit full morph dispatch to **direct type 2 bone morphs**. Full group morph composition and material/UV morphs are separate tasks. Do not falsely report those other morph types as implemented.
- Retain backward-compatible existing public MMDLoader/MMDAnimationHelper usage where feasible, and document any necessary runtime API.

## Local visual verification with real MMD models

First test candidate: **ビニール傘 (Vinyl umbrella), by 七篠権平衛**, whose distribution description explicitly identifies umbrella open/close as a bone morph: https://bowlroll.net/file/151308

Second candidate: **ワイヤーロープ (wire rope), by まりりん**, whose distribution description identifies bone+UV morph interaction: https://bowlroll.net/file/69264

- These are **candidate test assets** based on creators' descriptions, not yet validated PMX fixtures. After the maintainer legitimately downloads them, the local viewer must load each original PMX using actual `MMDLoader` and enumerate real type 2 morph names, target bones, weights and translation/rotation values; show a clear diagnostic when no type 2 morph is present.
- Provide a dedicated *loopback-only* model/morph viewer or safely extend the existing `npm run dev:sdef` private viewer, allowing direct morph selection and a 0–1 weight slider to inspect open/closed and intermediate states; support the model's normal texture paths. No real asset is required for CI or PR merge.
- Store models, textures and licenses in a Git-ignored local-only directory, e.g. `examples/assets/private/bone-morph/`. Read each archive's actual license/README before use; do **not** download/upload/commit/redistribute them automatically, copy them to Pages, ship them in npm, or assume permission to host them.
- **Do not change existing public examples** (PMD/VMD/VPD content, screenshots, indexes, asset manifest, Pages URLs). Consider any future replacement of publicly hosted example data separately only after reviewing actual distribution terms.

## Pre-merge acceptance criteria (fully automated)

- [ ] A public-npm `mmd-parser` release incorporating parser Issue #25 is consumed; package/lockfile changes are correct. If unpublished, leave this Issue open and explain the dependency, rather than implementing an incorrect coordinate workaround.
- [ ] Synthetic PMX fixture(s) distinguish type 2 from other morph types and contain nonzero translation and rotation with asymmetric components, at least two bones and multiple morphs affecting the same bone.
- [ ] At morph weight 0, bind/rest positions match unchanged output; at weight 1, translation/rotation match a mathematically independent CPU reference; intermediate weights interpolate correctly (including shortest-path rotation).
- [ ] Multiple bone morphs targeting one bone, simultaneous bone animation and VMD morph animation, resetting, looping and seeking do not accumulate transforms across frames.
- [ ] Animation helper both with default settings and `pmxAnimation: true` respects tested update ordering, with IK/grant/physics integration preserved or explicitly documented as a separate limitation supported by regression tests.
- [ ] Existing vertex morph animation remains unchanged, while type 2 bone morph weights now actually move the target bones and thereby deform a skinned mesh, including SDEF-containing geometry.
- [ ] WebGL2 rendering is exercised in browser CI; native WebGPU is exercised where available, using actual MMDLoader geometry/animations with assertions beyond successful shader compilation.
- [ ] Local-only real-model viewer supports selectable type 2 morph weights, reports morph and bone information, and offers BDEF/SDEF unaffected behavior as appropriate; absent third-party assets never fail CI.
- [ ] Guardrails/tests prove private asset directory and viewer are excluded from `npm pack`, `npm run build:examples` and GitHub Pages.
- [ ] Existing tests plus `npm run typecheck`, `npm test`, `npm run test:browser`, `npm run build:examples`, `npm run test:examples`, and isolated package consumer verification all pass before merge.
- [ ] No human visual approval, proprietary model download, account login, or post-merge deployment check is required for the agent to complete the PR.

## Required post-merge verification

**None** for Issue/PR completion. The maintainer may optionally inspect legitimately downloaded models in the private viewer afterwards; this does not block merge.

## Related

- [mmd-parser#25](https://github.com/takahirox/mmd-parser/issues/25) — bone morph handedness fix and new npm release prerequisite.
- [three-mmd-loader#26](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/issues/26) — completed SDEF implementation and private local viewer precedent.
